messages:
Maya (Marketing): Ok team — final push for the public launch + webinar next Thurs. Need social schedule for X + LinkedIn, assets from design, and engagement playbook. Can we lock times today?

Jon (Growth): Sounds good. Primary goal: drive webinar signups + demo requests. Secondary: amplify benchmark narrative (latency vs cost).

Priya (Content): Drafting three short thread variants for X and two LinkedIn carousels. Will post copy options in a bit. Need hero image + 30s clip.

Sam (Design): Got it. What are the specs? square for X and 1200x627 for LinkedIn feed? Any brand callouts?

Maya (Marketing): Yes — X: 1200x1200 PNG, LinkedIn feed: 1200x627 PNG, carousel slides: 1080x1080. Hero clip: 30s, 16:9, mp4 H.264, under 50MB. Add a slide summarizing benchmark numbers (latency/cost).

Ava (Social): Timing recs: X thread 2pm PT (high eng engagement), LinkedIn post 11am PT (mid-week best), reminder tweet 24h before, and day-of 1h before webinar. Can schedule via SocialBot.

Liam (Sales Ops): For inbound routing — add UTM params: utm_source=social, utm_medium=x|linkedin, utm_campaign=launch_webinar_may. Route signups with intent=yes to the SDR queue named "Inbound - Social" in HubSpot. Also add tag: "benchmark_interest" if they clicked the benchmark link.

Priya (Content): Copy idea 1 (X thread):
- Tweet 1: We just dropped a major update to Redwood Inference — faster, cheaper LLM inference at scale. TL;DR: 40% lower per-token cost on common workloads.
- Tweet 2: Join our webinar Thurs 9am PT to see benchmarks + live Q&A. RSVP: <link>
- Tweet 3: Benchmark highlight: 85ms median latency @ 2k tokens vs 150ms baseline. Screenshots in thread.

Sam (Design): I'll mock the benchmark slide and hero frame by EOD. Can someone paste the final numbers we want on slide? Don't want to overclaim.

Jon (Growth): Use conservative rounded numbers: 40% cost reduction, 80–90ms median latency for 2k tokens in our config. Call out testbed (g4dn-like) and include footnote: "results vary by model/hardware".

Ava (Social): Engagement playbook: when someone comments question about pricing — reply with short CTA + link to pricing page and add "DM to connect" for demo leads.

For high-intent responses (asks for SLA/dedicated) tag @Liam.

Liam (Sales Ops): Confirmed — SocialBot should post form results to HubSpot. If lead selects "Request demo" set lifecycle stage Lead > MQL and notify #sales-inbound. Who will map the form fields?

Maya (Marketing): Priya will finalize the copy and link to the registration form (with UTMs). Jon will set up the landing form mapping. Sam + Ava coordinate assets and scheduling.

Priya (Content): Draft LinkedIn carousel headlines: Slide1: "How Redwood cut inference cost by 40%"; Slide2: "Real-world benchmarks: cost & latency"; Slide3: "Join our webinar: live walkthrough + Q&A". Will write captions after final numbers.

Sam (Design): Early mock attached here when done. Need brand-approved color for call-to-action button — is it still #0057ff?

Maya (Marketing): Yes CTA blue #0057FF. Also include 16px rounded button for slides.

Ava (Social): Scheduling details for SocialBot: please queue posts for test on staging account first. Then main accounts: X thread 2024-07-31T14:00:00-07:00, LinkedIn 2024-07-31T11:00:00-07:00, Reminder X 2024-08-01T08:00:00-07:00, Day-of 2024-08-01T08:00:00-07:00 (1h before webinar at 9am PT).

SocialBot (scheduler): Scheduled: X thread -> 2024-07-31T14:00:00-07:00; LinkedIn -> 2024-07-31T11:00:00-07:00. Staging posts queued at 2024-07-30T10:00:00-07:00.

Jon (Growth): Asset requests: can we get 3 short clips (5–10s) showing benchmark graphs + 1 talking-head 30s clip for story? We'll use clips as carousel video + short reels.

Sam (Design): Will produce: 3 graph clips + 30s talking-head. Need transcript for 30s clip — Priya?

Priya (Content): On it. Drafting transcript now, will drop in thread in 20min.

Maya (Marketing): One more — engagement follow-ups templated replies for social team: short answers for FAQs and escalation script. Ava, can you write 6 quick reply templates?

Ava (Social): Yep. Quick ones:
1) Pricing question -> "We'll DM pricing details and link to pricing page: <pricing_url>?utm_campaign=launch_webinar_may"
2) SLA/dedicated ask -> "Thanks! Tagging @Liam — our sales ops will follow up for enterprise options."
3) Benchmark methodology -> "We've published a short methodology in the thread — feel free to DM for raw data."
4) Demo request -> "Book a demo: <link> — choose 'Inbound - Social' as source."
5) Webinar RSVP thank you -> "Thanks — see you Thu 9am PT! Add to calendar: <ics_link>"
6) Negative feedback -> "Appreciate the callout — can you DM specifics so we can follow up?"

Liam (Sales Ops): Perfect. Also ask SDRs to leave notes in HubSpot whether lead came from organic social vs paid amplification. We'll need that split for campaign ROI.

Maya (Marketing): Great. Final checklist:
- [ ] Priya: final copy + transcript (today)
- [ ] Sam: hero + slides + clips (EOD)
- [ ] Ava: schedule + engagement templates (today)
- [ ] Jon: UTMs + landing form mapping (today)
- [ ] Liam: HubSpot pipeline + notify rule (today)

Priya (Content): Copy + transcript uploaded to Google Drive: https://drive.company/redwood/launch-assets (placeholder).

Sam (Design): Uploading mock v1 now. Will ping when finalized.

Ava (Social): I'll draft the thread cadence in SocialBot after assets in. After posting we should monitor first 2 hours for high-intent replies.

Jon (Growth): If we get >50 signups in first hour consider increasing paid boost for the LinkedIn post.

Maya (Marketing): Thanks team. If anyone hits blockers, drop them here. Otherwise we'll reconvene at 4pm PT for final sign-off. :rocket:
